facts.text: Tim read a story about two hikers who trekked through the Himalayas.

evidence.quote: I read a few of them. One of them is about two hikers who trekked through the Himalayas, sounds awesome!

facts.text: The story mentioned that the trek through the Himalayas was tough but worth it, with challenging terrain, altitude sickness, and bad weather.

evidence.quote: The book mentioned that the trek was tough but worth it, with challenging terrain, altitude sickness, and bad weather.

facts.text: Tim was motivated by the story of the two hikers who completed the trek through the Himalayas and saw amazing sights.

evidence.quote: But they made it and saw amazing sights - it really motivated me.

facts.text: Tim visited a travel agency to see what the requirements would be for his next dream trip.
